description: Source file implementing SPDY/HTTP2 metadata extension handling, including frame sequence generation, metadata support detection, and payload processing.

classes.name: MetadataFrameSequence
classes.description: Handles creation of metadata frames with optional HPACK compression disabled.

classes.name: MetadataVisitor
classes.description: Processes SPDY/HTTP2 metadata frames, manages support detection, and decodes HPACK-encoded metadata payloads.

methods.name: MetadataFrameSequence::MetadataFrameSequence
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a metadata frame sequence with a given stream ID and header block payload.

methods.name: MetadataFrameSequence::HasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more frames to generate in the sequence.

methods.name: MetadataFrameSequence::Next
methods.description: Generates the next metadata frame IR, respecting HTTP/2 frame size limits.

methods.name: MetadataVisitor::OnSetting
methods.description: Handles SPDY/HTTP2 settings related to metadata support.

methods.name: MetadataVisitor::OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Processes the header of a metadata frame, initializing payload state.

methods.name: MetadataVisitor::OnFramePayload
methods.description: Processes payload data of a metadata frame, decodes HPACK-encoded header block when complete.
